verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਤਖਤੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu saadhasa(n)gat sach takhat suhelaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru (God) is the true emperor and the holy congregation is true throne which is most delightful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਟਕਸਾਲ ਸਚੁ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਪਾਰਸ ਮੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sach sabadh Takasaal sach asaTadhaat ik paaras melaa|

en.bdb: The true Word is such a true mint where different castes in the from of metals meet the Guru, the philosopher's stone, and become gold (gurmukhs).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਵਹਾਣੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sachaa abichal raaj hai sach mahal navahaan navelaa|

en.bdb: There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੋ ਰਸ ਕੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sachaa hukam varatadhaa sachaa amar sacho ras kelaa|

en.bdb: There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sachee sifat salaeh sach sach salaahan a(n)mirat velaa|

en.bdb: There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sachaa gurmukh pa(n)th hai sach upadhes na garab gahelaa|

en.bdb: There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: aasaa vich niraas gat sachaa khel mel sach khelaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs remain detached among many hopes and they always play the game of truth.
Such gurmukhs become Guru and the Guru becomes their disciple.
